answer: One concrete mechanism: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because marble only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, violet is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any yarrow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
